candidates.title: Deploy decision models with llama.cpp on Amazon SageMaker AI
candidates.summary: Learn how to deploy decision models with llama.cpp on Amazon SageMaker AI. This technical how-to serves OpenAI-compatible chat completions with the AWS Deep Learning Container for llama.cpp, then extends the runtime with SemIf to return probabilities over declared options on CPU or GPU.

candidates.title: Run multi-node inference workloads using Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers
candidates.summary: Learn how to deploy one large language model across two GPU nodes on Amazon EKS using the multi-node Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers, with separate prefill and decode nodes behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The pre-built container ships the full inference stack, so you configure the deployment instead of assembling it.

candidates.title: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
candidates.summary: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?
